title: fix(components): select-all draws a dash for a partial selection
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：列表（data-table，ObjectGrid 也经它渲染）表头全选框在「部分选中」时画一条横杠，不再画对勾；全选仍是对勾，未选为空。
- 为什么改：部分选中时表头看起来和「全部选中」一模一样，用户可能误以为整页都选上了再去跑批量操作。
- 风险与回滚：只换了表头全选这一处的复选框组件，行内复选框与上游 Shadcn `ui/checkbox.tsx` 未动；回滚即还原 data-table 那一行 import 与标签。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/custom/tri-state-checkbox.tsx`（新的内部包装），`data-table.tsx` 表头全选那一处。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-selectAllMixed-27807.test.tsx`，预期 3/3 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27807

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- New package-internal `TriStateCheckbox` in `ui/packages/components/src/custom/tri-state-checkbox.tsx`, built on the Radix checkbox primitive with the same classes as the Shadcn `Checkbox`: `checked="indeterminate"` draws a lucide `Minus` (dash) and takes the checked fill; `true` draws the check; `false` draws nothing. It is **not** re-exported from `custom/index.ts`, so the package's public surface is unchanged (`Clause-②: no`).
- `data-table.tsx`: the header select-all (the only call site in `ui/packages/**` that passes `'indeterminate'`) uses `TriStateCheckbox`. Row checkboxes keep the Shadcn `Checkbox`.
- ⛔ No edit under `ui/packages/components/src/ui/**` (ui/AGENTS.md #7 No-Touch zone).

### Measured repro / call sites (on `origin/main` at 86aaff32)

- The Tasks → Bulk Actions view is an object grid; `ObjectGrid` builds a `type: 'data-table'` schema and renders it through `SchemaRenderer`, so the header checkbox is the components data-table's.
- `git grep -n indeterminate` over `ui/packages/*/src` (non-test, excluding `src/ui/`): exactly one checkbox call site, the data-table header select-all (`somePageRowsSelected ? 'indeterminate' : false`). The other hits are progress bars and comments.
- Mechanism confirmed in `ui/checkbox.tsx`: the Radix `Indicator` renders for `checked` and `indeterminate`, and its only child is `Check`.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-selectAllMixed-27807.test.tsx`:
- one of three rows selected → header `aria-checked="mixed"`, dash glyph present, check glyph absent;
- control: all selected → `aria-checked="true"`, check present, dash absent;
- control: none selected → `aria-checked="false"`, no glyph.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablation (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the header select-all's opening tag `TriStateCheckbox` swapped back to `Checkbox` in `data-table.tsx`, landed 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): the partial-selection test went red, as did the all-selected control (the upstream check carries no `data-glyph` marker); the none-selected control stayed green. Tests 2 failed | 1 passed.
- The wrapper mirrors the Shadcn checkbox classes by copy. If a future shadcn sync changes `ui/checkbox.tsx` styling, the header select-all will not follow automatically.

## Verification

See the report comment on #27807 for the gate list (`dispatch-gates --commands` derived, each `command :: exit code`) and the test runs.
